sources.description: Real mapped footprints and road geometry downloaded from https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter. OSM completeness varies. Roads are clipped to the reference extent; crossing-boundary buildings are excluded rather than modeled as partial buildings. This rectangular reference extent is not a ZIP boundary.

sources.name: Urban Planning reference inference v1
sources.description: Missing heights use levels × 3.5 m; missing levels use documented use/footprint heuristics (1–5 floors). Uses follow OSM tags where available, otherwise small buildings are assumed residential and larger buildings office. Dwelling counts use mapped flats or 100 m² gross floor area per apartment. Job counts are unvalidated capacity estimates using gross floor area × illustrative jobs per 1,000 ft²: office 4, retail/school 2, industrial 1.5, warehouse 0.5, healthcare/civic 3. Apartment counts can overstate capacity where tower/podium floorplates differ. Parking structures use 30 m² per space; surface and on-street parking have not been inventoried. These are not observed population, employment, or parking counts. All building attributes remain marked estimated.

coverage.description: 1774 real OSM footprints in the reference extent. Source completeness varies.
